svg.text: The night-world of Vampire: The Dark Ages — the crown of Buda-Pest beset on every side
Cainite spheres of influence, not mortal borders. Numbered sites keyed at right. The West and Dar al-Islam lie beyond this chronicle’s frame.
The Holy Roman Empire — Ventrue & Lasombra
The Papal States — contested — no prince
The Italian city-states — ancillae — mixed clans
The Baltic frontier — no Cainite lord
The War of Princes (West) — Ventrue & Lasombra

Sources: Vampire: The Dark Ages 20th Anniversary, Ch.9 (the Dark Medieval gazetteer); chronicle “Crown of Ice and Bone.” Clan holdings are those the gazetteer names; where it names none (Serbia, the Baltic, Nicaea/Epirus, the West), that is shown.
Cainite power in this age is city-based and porous: these are spheres of influence, not surveyed borders.
